scope: No new native executions. Pure extraction from candidate_A/native.json.gz plus exact current source formula and initial native actor stats. Shield absorption excludes concurrent-shield duplicated pool wear; native absorbed is effective prevented HP damage. Healing uses actual capped heal log, excluding overheal. The combat-entry weapon HP increase is recorded, never invented as enemy damage.

formula.native: raw * defenseBase / (defenseBase + combatStat(target,def)) * criticalMultiplier * combatDamageMultiplier * random(.95..1.05), followed by applyDamage status/trait modifiers and shield absorption.
formula.growthCombatDef: combatStat base DEF / sqrt(1+.12*(level-1)+.003*(level-1)^2), before dynamic modifiers
formula.limitation: Exact per-packet pre-defense expected value cannot be reconstructed from stored actor boundary alone. Nominal normalization is descriptive, not formula verification or PRNG replay.

packets.nominalNormalizationLimit: Uses initial raw DEF/growth sqrt and native defenseBase; not exact per-packet dynamic statuses/guard/reaction/crit/random/traits reconstruction.
